name: Mindful Thought Observation
equipment: A quiet space and a comfortable seat
instructions: Settle into a comfortable seated position, close your eyes, and take several grounding breaths.
Shift your attention to the mind itself, observing thoughts as they arise without trying to control them.
As each thought appears, gently label its category — "planning," "judging," "remembering" — and watch it dissolve.
Notice any patterns or recurring themes in your thoughts, observing them with curiosity rather than criticism.
Rest in the quiet gaps between thoughts, letting your awareness rest there a little longer each time.
If strong emotions arise with a thought, acknowledge them kindly before returning to observation.
In the final minute, let go of labeling and simply rest in open, spacious awareness before slowly opening your eyes.
